The number of stochastic passes has no measurable effect on DSC: 5 passes give the same single-pass result as 30 (difference 0.00 pp). SCZ with 15 passes per run uses 26 passes per image, fewer than the standard single pass, and gains 2.16 pp.

Estimates with fewer passes are prefixes of one 30-pass run; inference time with fewer passes was not measured. By the protocol no configuration replaces the locked method; cheaper configurations are operating points identified after the fact on test sets used before.
